question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill In blank no. 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **training**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Training**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• It refers to the act of teaching or learning a specific skill or behaviour. (किसी विशिष्ट कौशल या व्यवहार को सिखाने या सीखने की क्रिया)
 
• In the context of the sentence, it could refer to the training of a person or animal to behave in a certain way.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

Complete passage: *Redwing had read (1) somewhere__ that one of his favourite writers, Ernest Hemingway, had been asked what was the best **(2) **__**training** __for a novelist. He had said "an unhappy childhood". Redwing had enjoyed a fine time growing up, but he (3) ______ if this whole (4) ______ was unfolding more like a novel, and would be (5) ______ on one person, one character, the guy in charge: him. Maybe you got a happy childhood and then an unhappy adulthood, and that's how novels worked.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Nature **refers to inherent qualities which do not fit the context of the sentence. (अंतर्निहित गुण)
 
• **Medication **refers to drugs or medicine which does not fit the context of the sentence. (औषधि या दवा)
 
• **Maintenance **refers to upkeep or repair which does not fit the context of the sentence. (रखरखाव या मरम्मत)
